doc.title: Buddy Burns and Frank Pasley Interview, 1968-09-23

title: Dink Johnson, George Baquet and Jimmy Palao in California
summary: They discuss Dink Johnson, who came west with King Oliver's band, and others playing in Los Angeles before 1917.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: And Dink. Yeah, Dink. Dink Johnson. Yeah. You know Dink? Yeah. He was a great piano player and great drummer and…
He played drums when he first came here. I think he came here in Joe Oliver's band.
Oh, George Bucket is played here in California?
Down at the theater in the 7th in the Hill.
That's before I came here in 1917. I think he was playing with Joe Oliver. Yeah.
